# Keeping Up with Startup World Trends

## 📰 Key Publications & Newsletters
- **TechCrunch** - breaking startup news
- **The Information** - deep tech journalism
- **Stratechery** - tech strategy analysis
- **Morning Brew / The Hustle** - digestible daily news
- **CB Insights Newsletter** - data-driven insights

## 🎙️ Podcasts
- How I Built This (NPR)
- Acquired
- Founders podcast
- 20VC (Twenty Minute VC)
- My First Million

## 🌐 Online Communities
- **Hacker News** (news.ycombinator.com) - very active
- **Product Hunt** - new product launches
- **Reddit** (r/startups, r/entrepreneur)
- **Twitter/X** - follow founders & VCs directly

## 👥 People to Follow
- Investors/VCs (a16z, Sequoia partners)
- Active founders building in public
- Tech journalists

## 📊 Data & Research
- **Crunchbase** - funding rounds
- **PitchBook** - market data
- **CB Insights** - trend reports

## 💡 Practical Habits
- Set aside **30 min daily** for reading
- Attend **startup events/meetups**
- Join **accelerator communities** (even as observer)
- **Build a network** of founders

## ⚡ Quick Tip
> Focus on **2-3 sources** you trust rather than consuming everything - quality over quantity.

What specific area of startups are you most interested in?
